## Type of change

<!-- Keep the one that matches the PR title (Conventional Commits). -->

- [ ] `feat` new functionality
- [ ] `fix` bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` no behavior change
- [ ] `perf` performance improvement
- [ ] `test` tests only
- [ ] `docs` documentation only
- [ ] `build` / `ci` build system, Docker, workflows
- [ ] `chore` maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed behavior
- [ ] `make check lint test` passes locally
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md) where relevant
- [ ] Swagger regenerated with `make swagger` if the API changed
- [ ] No secrets, keys or credentials committed
